name: Tsimbazaza Botanical and Zoological Park
subtitle: A park in the city that began as a botanical garden and also keeps animals, notably ring-tailed lemurs.

facts.label: Creation
facts.value: Created 29 August 1925 by Governor General Marcel Olivier; 12 hectares at first.

facts.label: Area
facts.value: 16 hectares in 1932; 27 hectares after a 1934 annexation.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: It started as a botanical garden.

facts.label: Lemurs
facts.value: The ring-tailed lemur is described as emblematic.

parts.text: A park in the city that began as a botanical garden and also keeps animals, notably ring-tailed lemurs. It holds a herbarium and a library bequeathed by the Grandidiers.
